patternCandidates.name: Plan catalogue list (L1, dark hero)
patternCandidates.whenToUse: Captain must browse and compare several earning plans and pick one to inspect
patternCandidates.structure: Dark navy hero (circle back, MY PLAN lottie logo, "Choose Your Earning Plan") > section dividers ("₹0 To Start", "Recharge Plans") > stacked plan cards (persona tag pill, eyebrow, big value + struck old value, plan type + (Free/Paid Plan), play-video icon, secondary "View Details" button) > active plan card with green border + "Active Plan" badge
patternCandidates.variations: light-body refresh on L1 design page (5603:35850); performance-grouped with locks (Quality BYOB); CARD OPTIONS page tests no-CTA / play icon / watch-video CTA / no-details cards
patternCandidates.conflicts: CTA style differs: black outline pill (L2 page) vs blue outline pill with chevron (L1 design); hero dark vs light body

patternCandidates.name: Plan detail + sticky activate (L2)
patternCandidates.whenToUse: Captain needs to understand one plan (what is included / deducted) before committing
patternCandidates.structure: InternalPageHeader("Plan Details") > summary card (tag pill, title, subtitle) > video ingress card > inclusion list card (green plus/orange minus rows) > Know More check list > sticky footer: info note + primary yellow "Activate Plan"
patternCandidates.variations: Quality BYOB adds performance-ladder card; MG plans add zone chip/time window; plan-switch shows "starts after current plan ends" note

patternCandidates.name: Radio plan selector with sticky summary footer (Bike SaaS)
patternCandidates.whenToUse: Captain chooses exactly one of several priced options and confirms
patternCandidates.structure: InternalPageHeader(title, Help chip) > promo hero banner > grouped sections (title + audio explainer icon) of radio rows (title, meta, price right) > Important info note > T&C bullets > sticky footer (PLAN SELECTED label + name + price, primary yellow CTA)
components: local Plan Option Card/Row, Badge Pill
patternCandidates.variations: single plan vs multiple sections; active plan state replaces selector at top
patternCandidates.conflicts: L1 list uses cards + View Details instead of radio + sticky; two different selection idioms for the same "pick a plan" job

patternCandidates.name: Activation confirmation modal
patternCandidates.whenToUse: Immediately after an irreversible/important activation succeeds
patternCandidates.structure: Dimmed source page > centred white card: green check, "<Plan> Active", one-line body, primary yellow "Okay"; preceded by spinner card "Please wait"
patternCandidates.conflicts: Uses centred modal while result-of-window uses bottom sheet

patternCandidates.name: Active progress card (target tracker)
patternCandidates.whenToUse: Captain has an active goal (earnings/rides/time) and needs status at a glance
patternCandidates.structure: Card: status tag (Active/Completed/Upcoming) + plan name + fee; primary metric "₹x/₹500" with linear bar; secondary segmented ride bar "6/9 rides"; status line with icon (green check / red x / yellow)
patternCandidates.variations: home collapsible version vs plan page version; countdown timer for unlimited; ring progress explored in kitchen (8245:26447)
patternCandidates.conflicts: colour semantics: blue progress (home) vs green (plan page)

patternCandidates.name: Outcome bottom sheet with tinted header
patternCandidates.whenToUse: End of a plan window – tell the captain the financial outcome
patternCandidates.structure: Dimmed home > close X > sheet with tinted top (green confetti success / yellow warn / blue neutral) showing card snapshot > bold title with amount > body > full-width yellow OK
patternCandidates.variations: fee charged / cashback got / cashback missed / no fee

patternCandidates.name: Loss-aversion nudge banner inside existing card
patternCandidates.whenToUse: Show missed money and a switch-plan CTA on Earnings / Order details
patternCandidates.structure: Inside Today's Earnings card: light-blue panel with MY PLAN logo, 2-line copy ("You missed ₹100 today…"), dark navy pill CTA "View KM Plan →"; on order details a one-line row with chevron
patternCandidates.variations: EPKM vs fixed commission copy; CT banner standalone version
patternCandidates.conflicts: dark navy pill CTA is off-system vs yellow primary; text overflows in 6/7 locales

patternCandidates.name: Locked option explanation modal
patternCandidates.whenToUse: Captain taps an option they are not eligible for
patternCandidates.structure: Dimmed list > close X above card > white card: lock icon, "This plan is not for you", reason copy; no button
patternCandidates.variations: per tier × plan type copy matrix (5206:34830)
patternCandidates.conflicts: modal has no primary action (only X) unlike other modals

patternCandidates.name: Full-screen intro takeover
patternCandidates.whenToUse: First exposure to a new plan type / feature
patternCandidates.structure: Dark full-screen, back circle, logo, highlighted card with audio button, single green CTA
patternCandidates.conflicts: green CTA vs yellow primary elsewhere
